basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Science and Technology (UST) Graduate Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Science and Technology (UST) & Government of South Korea (MSIT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: UST Main Campus & 32 South Korean Government Research Institutes (KIST, ETRI, KARI, KRICT, KIMS, KIER, KBRI, KISTI, KRISS)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Advanced STEM Disciplines: Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Semiconductor Technology, Aerospace Engineering, Biotechnology, Advanced Materials, Nuclear Engineering, Quantum Computing, Environmental Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~400 to 500 new international researchers admitted annually across 32 research institutes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Large active Pakistani researcher community; Pakistan is among the top 3 represented international nations at UST (typically 35 to 60 Pakistani awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full normative duration of degree: 2 years (MS), 4 years (PhD), or 5 years (Integrated MS-PhD)

nationality_requirements: International citizens whose parents are both non-Korean citizens
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA; practical engineering competencies and lab research capabilities are heavily weighted.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate/Master's major directly relevant to the chosen government research campus field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Lab experience, prior publications, and hands-on experimental equipment expertise are significant assets.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 79, IELTS Academic min 6.0, New TEPS min 277, or Duolingo English Test min 100.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: No Korean language required; courses and research in English (Korean classes provided free).

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided for all semesters (KRW 2,500,000 / semester).

admission_application_fee.details: UST application fee (KRW 35,000 or USD $30) paid online by applicant.

accommodation.details: Subsidized on-site researcher dormitories located directly inside the 32 national research institutes (rent ~KRW 100,000 to 200,000/mo) paid from monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly research stipend paid by host research institute: Minimum KRW 1,350,000/month for Master's; Minimum KRW 1,800,000/month for PhD (~PKR 285,000 to 380,000/month). Top labs provide performance bonuses up to KRW 2,200,000/month.

airfare.details: International travel expenses to South Korea borne by student.

visa_fee.details: South Korean D-2 student visa processing fee paid by applicant; UST provides Certificate of Admission.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive student safety insurance provided by UST; National Health Insurance (NHIS) subsidized.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized cafeteria meals inside national institute campuses (~KRW 3,500 to 5,000 per meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to national supercomputing facilities, state-of-the-art cleanrooms, synchrotron beamlines, and lab facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: UST Overseas Training and International Conference Presentation Grants (up to KRW 3,000,000 per trip).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single university system: UST with 32 specialized government research institute campuses.
participating_institutions: Korea Institute of Science and Technology (KIST, Seoul)
Electronics and Telecommunications Research Institute (ETRI, Daejeon)
Korea Research Institute of Chemical Technology (KRICT)
Korea Institute of Science and Technology Information (KISTI)
Korea Research Institute of Standards and Science (KRISS)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: National flagship research institution; #1 in South Korea for R&D budget per student; 100% research institute embedded.
available_majors: Artificial Intelligence, ICT & Software, Robotics & Autonomous Systems, Aerospace Engineering, Semiconductor & Display Engineering, Advanced Materials, Chemical Technology, Biotechnology, Nuclear Engineering, Quantum Information Science
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering/science, official English proficiency score, and strong research aptitude.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: KIST (Seoul) and ETRI (Daejeon) receive the highest application volumes; chemical, energy, and materials institutes have slightly higher admission ratios.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Reaching out to prospective principal researchers (professors) at the target government institute before applying significantly enhances selection chances.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the UST Online Admissions System during the Spring or Fall admissions window.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Search open research project areas and professor profiles on UST admissions portal (March/September).
2. Create account on UST online application system.
3. Select target campus (e.g. KIST, ETRI) and major specialization.
4. Upload Study Plan, transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and English test score.
5. Register 1 or 2 academic referees who upload letters of recommendation.
7. First screening: Document evaluation by central committee and campus faculty.
8. Second screening: Video interview conducted by institute professors (April/October).
9. Final results announced in May (Fall intake) or November (Spring intake).
10. Receive Certificate of Admission and apply for Korean D-2 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic appointment: all admitted UST students receive full fellowship appointment as student researchers.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via UST automated email link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Self-Introduction and Study Plan explaining academic motivations, technical strengths, and proposed research trajectory at the national lab.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research plan answering specific questions regarding proposed lab research, methodology, and career vision.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing technical projects, software/hardware competencies, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: In-depth 20-30 minute technical video interview covering fundamentals, previous research, and research vision.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE not required; English proficiency test required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Apostille or Korean Embassy legalization of degree certificate and official transcript.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English or Korean translations required.

Complete transcripts and degrees with grading scales
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan, MOFA, and Korean Embassy in Islamabad (or Apostille)

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed using the official UST template
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on experimental capabilities and lab fit

TOEFL iBT (79+), IELTS Academic (6.0+), or Duolingo (100+)

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two admissions cycles per year: Fall intake (opens March, starts September) and Spring intake (opens September, starts March).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Academic transcript grades and foundational STEM preparation)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Research publications, thesis, laboratory techniques, experimental skills)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality of Study Plan and research goals)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Chief research scientists and professors at the respective government research institute campuses.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document evaluation by research faculty -> In-depth technical video interview -> Final selection committee approval.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~400 to 500 fully funded student researcher appointments per year
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8% to 10% (Strong track record of Pakistani admissions)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from NUST, COMSATS, UET, GIKI, FAST, and Quaid-i-Azam with solid hands-on engineering/science laboratory skills, final-year design projects, and strong motivation.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani researchers have a vibrant alumni network at KIST, ETRI, and KRICT, frequently transitioning to Korean tech giants (Samsung, LG, SK Hynix).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Vietnam, Pakistan, India, Indonesia, Bangladesh, China, Russia, Iran.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of KRW 35,000 / USD $30 is paid strictly inside the official UST application portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: UST does not authorize commercial consultants to solicit or evaluate applications.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Degree legalization / Apostille and HEC/MOFA attestation fees (~PKR 35,000 to 55,000)
Airfare Pakistan to Seoul Incheon (~PKR 170,000 to 250,000)
Initial 1-month living funds before first stipend payment (~KRW 500,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: UST is a traditional university with classroom lectures. (Truth: UST is a research university where students work full-time directly inside national laboratories as junior researchers).
MYTH: You cannot transition to a PhD. (Truth: UST has direct Integrated MS-PhD tracks and seamless transitions for high-performing Master's students).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial agents claim Korean proficiency is mandatory; in reality, UST research and courses are conducted 100% in English.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum 3.00 GPA in graduate coursework and meet research institute laboratory deliverables.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time laboratory presence as a student researcher at the assigned government research institute.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual research progress reports and publication milestones required for thesis defense.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time outside employment is strictly restricted to ensure dedicated research focus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; international graduates qualify for South Korea's D-10 job seeker visa and E-7 professional researcher work visa pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Fellowship is cancelled if student is dismissed for disciplinary reasons or abandons laboratory research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing campuses or research institutes requires extraordinary approval from UST President.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Degree duration follows strict normative limits; research stipend can be extended for thesis finalization with advisor approval.
